# Geocode Batch Files

> **Status:** Stub — content to be expanded.

## Overview

How to process batches of addresses or queries from text/CSV files via the CLI.

## Batch search

```bash
barangay batch batch-search queries.txt --limit 5 --output results.json
```

## Batch validate

```bash
barangay batch validate addresses.txt
```
